summary: Read a binary tree whose node count is between 1 and 1000. Every node stores the value 0. Cameras may be placed on chosen nodes. A camera sitting on a node watches that node's parent, the node itself, and the node's direct children. Choose a set of placements so that every node is watched by at least one camera, and so that the number of cameras is as small as possible. Write that smallest number.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
